The decisive mistake was at Step 0. The Debugging_Problem_Solving_Expert accepted a debugging framing ("resolve the error with exit code 1") that had nothing to do with the grocery-list task, and built a plan around a nonexistent error. Every later agent followed that framing, and none of them went back to the actual request: sorting the vegetables (broccoli, celery, fresh basil, lettuce, sweet potatoes) and excluding botanical fruits like bell pepper, plums, and zucchini. The conversation ended at Step 9 with a TERMINATE and no answer, but that step only closed a derailment that Step 0 had already set in motion.
